intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with GATE. This page compares recorded year fees, the ranks we hold, and official sites opened in {{year}}.

DTU vs IIT Delhi is not a close ranking fight. IIT Delhi holds a NIRF 2025 rank of 2, recorded against M.Tech / M.E. DTU is listed at 30 in the same year. Both placement rows we hold are older than 2020.

sections.heading: DTU vs IIT Delhi for M.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIT Delhi if you want a public IIT M.Tech through GATE, with a recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹1.50 lakh and a NIRF 2025 rank of 2, after you confirm the official postgraduate fee circular.
Choose DTU if a public university M.Tech in Delhi is the seat you have, with recorded Total Fees year figures of ₹1.66 lakh and ₹1.692 lakh on the same programme rows, and a NIRF 2025 rank of 30.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For DTU we hold two Total Fees year figures, ₹1.66 lakh and ₹1.692 lakh, on the same M.Tech programme rows. We have not chosen one as official, and we have not added them together.

For IIT Delhi we hold ₹1.50 lakh as a Total Fees year figure on several M.Tech rows. Confirm the official IIT Delhi postgraduate circular, because itemised heads and deposits can differ by category and hostel.
Check the current notices on dtu.ac.in and iitd.ac.in before you budget. Do not invent a first-semester total we have not opened in an official circular.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: DTU's only M.Tech row here is from 2017, with a highest of ₹52 lakh for applied physics and no usable average. That year is too old to treat as a current flagship figure.
IIT Delhi's only M.Tech row here is from 2015, with ₹9 lakh average and ₹45 lakh highest for atmospheric-oceanic sciences. That year is also too old for a 2026 comparison.
Ask both placement cells for a later official M.Tech report. Do not stretch these old rows into a current package comparison.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both are listed with GATE. IIT Delhi and DTU M.Tech admissions follow the official GATE process and each institute's seat-allocation rules, including COAP where it applies.
On our records, IIT Delhi has NIRF ranks of 2 in 2025 and 2024, recorded against M.Tech / M.E. DTU has NIRF ranks of 30 in 2025 and 27 in 2024. Confirm the current Engineering list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are public institutes in Delhi, so a local student can visit them on the same trip. They are not interchangeable campuses.
IIT Delhi is an Institute of National Importance. DTU is a state university. Match the exact M.Tech specialisation, labs and offer letter.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick IIT Delhi if a public IIT M.Tech and the NIRF 2025 rank of 2 are the goal, after you have the official postgraduate fee circular in hand.
Pick DTU if that is the seat you have been offered, after you confirm which of the two recorded year fees is current.
Do not decide from the 2017 DTU or 2015 IIT Delhi placement rows.

faqs.question: What M.Tech fees are on record for DTU and IIT Delhi?
faqs.answer: DTU has two Total Fees year figures, ₹1.66 lakh and ₹1.692 lakh, on the same programme rows. IIT Delhi has a Total Fees year figure of ₹1.50 lakh. Confirm official circulars before you budget.

faqs.question: Are recent M.Tech placements available?
faqs.answer: Not on this page. DTU has only a 2017 row, and IIT Delhi has only a 2015 row. Both years are too old to use as current figures. Ask both campuses for a later official report.

faqs.question: Which college has the better NIRF rank?
faqs.answer: IIT Delhi has a NIRF rank of 2 in 2025 and 2024, recorded against M.Tech / M.E. DTU has a NIRF rank of 30 in 2025 and 27 in 2024. Confirm the official Engineering list.

faqs.question: Do both programmes use GATE?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are listed with GATE. Follow the official GATE process and each institute's seat-allocation rules.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are public institutes recorded in Delhi. IIT Delhi is an Institute of National Importance, and DTU is a state university.

faqs.question: Should I add DTU's two year figures together?
faqs.answer: No. They are two recorded Total Fees year figures on the same programme rows. Confirm which official circular is current.
